name: One-Way (Unilateral) Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A one-directional NDA where a single Disclosing Party shares confidential information with a Receiving Party.

sections.heading: Parties
sections.body: This One-Way Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of {{effective_date}} between {{disclosing_party_name}}, located at {{disclosing_party_address}} (the "Disclosing Party"), and {{receiving_party_name}}, located at {{receiving_party_address}} (the "Receiving Party").

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: The Disclosing Party will share certain Confidential Information with the Receiving Party for the purpose of {{purpose}} (the "Purpose").

sections.heading: 2. Confidential Information
sections.body: "Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by the Disclosing Party that is marked confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential. It excludes information that is public through no fault of the Receiving Party, was already known to the Receiving Party without restriction, is rightfully received from a third party, or is independently developed without use of the Confidential Information.

sections.heading: 3. Obligations of the Receiving Party
sections.body: The Receiving Party will use the Confidential Information only for the Purpose, protect it with at least reasonable care, and not disclose it to third parties except to personnel and advisors who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement.

sections.heading: 4. Confidentiality Period
sections.body: The Receiving Party's obligations under this Agreement survive for {{confidentiality_period_months}} months following each disclosure of Confidential Information.

sections.heading: 5. Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the {{governing_law}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.
